ambiguities.text: Security Considerations section is present but contains no detailed content
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard blob security considerations apply. Analyze for potential DoS vectors from separated blob/tx propagation.
Assume standard devp2p error handling applies. Missing blobs in response should be handled gracefully.

ambiguities.text: PooledBlobs message code assignment 'pending' - exact message code not finalized
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume message code will be assigned before deployment. Use placeholder for analysis.

ambiguities.text: Recipients may skip unavailable blobs from the request - unclear how to signal which blobs were skipped
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume response maintains ordering correspondence with request, using null/empty entries for unavailable blobs.

implicit_assumptions.description: Peers will eventually provide blob data for announced transactions
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Transactions could be announced but blobs never provided, causing mempool pollution and incomplete transaction state.

implicit_assumptions.description: The separation of blob and transaction propagation does not create race conditions where transaction is processed before blobs arrive
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Could create inconsistent mempool states or allow transactions to be included in blocks without valid blobs.

implicit_assumptions.description: RBF (replace-by-fee) scenarios maintain blob availability when only fees change
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: RBF could cause blob data loss if original transaction's blobs are discarded before replacement is validated.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot efficiently enumerate blob vhashes without having observed corresponding transactions
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Could enable blob preimage attacks or information leakage about pending transactions.
